name: NCW Weekly Poll: Best Match of the Week
epitaph: The fed's own recurring reader poll, voted weekly from 18 March to 21 October 1997 -- not an idle popularity contest but the engine of the fed's rankings: winners earned a Victory Point, and Victory Points decided who entered the Free-for-All. Structured here from 11 of the series' 13 known editions.

bestowals.vote_detail: Mist v. the Jammer -- Results published in the following week's edition; also cited as Best Angle Potential (tied with LaShawn Marcus vs. the Trooper).
bestowals.source: Citing the fed's own NCW Weekly Poll series (13 editions, 18 March-21 October 1997); a reader poll with a real scoring mechanic (winners earned a Victory Point feeding the fed's own rankings and Free-for-All seeding).

name: NCW Weekly Poll: Best Wrestler (Male)
epitaph: Added to the fed's own weekly poll in September 1997 as an aggregate the operator alone computed across every other category (readers could not vote on it directly), introduced after repeated cases of a popular wrestler losing the ordinary Face/Heel vote to a split field.

bestowals.vote_detail: Week of 3 October 1997 (barely beating the Trooper).
bestowals.source: the accession digest (workshop record), citing the fed's own NCW Weekly Poll, week of 3 October 1997 -- the final edition of the series in this collection's own record.
